messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: pager fired: high 5xx rate on inference-gateway-usw2 (error-rate > 5% over 3m). alert: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/alerts/345
pagerduty: PagerDuty: INC-4729 auto-page -> maria (oncall)
maria: Acked. Looking at graphs now, thanks. Any recent deploys?
jon: No deploys in the last 30m from release-bot. Saw a small routing weight change 8m ago to canary pool.
maria: k, checking logs at the edge and gateway.
carol: I can help with pool/eviction checks if needed.
maria: Logs show a gradual ramp of 502 responses from svc-inference-proxy instances in pool-6. Example trace:
```
2024-07-13T02:02:13Z ERROR proxy: upstream 10.42.11.23:502 "KV cache stall" route=/v1/generate
```
jon: KV cache eviction metrics spiked at the same time (kvcache.evictions +420%). Likely cache churn due to increased seq lengths from a customer test.
maria: Impact: region-wide 5xx spike, ~7% of requests in last 3m, some 502s for customers on dedicated routes. No full service outage but user-facing errors on streaming calls.
carol: Quick mitigation idea: reduce routing weight to pool-6 and route traffic to pool-2 which is warm. I can run weight-update if approved.
maria: Do it. Also start a warmup by hitting pool-2 with a low-priority background fanout to populate KV caches.
carol: Running:
```
./infra-router set-weight --pool pool-6 --weight 10
./infra-router set-weight --pool pool-2 --weight 90
```
carol: Done. Confirmed new weights propagated.
jon: KVCACHE evictions are dropping, error-rate trending down to ~2.1%.
maria: Starting a targeted warmup script to prime common prefixes to pool-2 (low qps).
maria: warmup job submitted: job/prime-kv-pool-2-172880
pagerduty: PagerDuty: reminder -> update INC-4729 within 30m.
sarah: I'm on next shift in 20m, will take handoff if this stabilizes.
carol: Also pinned a temporary fallback model-variant for routes hitting the problematic instances so we avoid long sequence drivers.
jon: Confirmed fallback variant applied via routing rules for customer routes: customer-skus 123, 789.
maria: Error-rate stabilized under 1.5% over 5m. Streaming errors reduced.
maria: Customer impact: brief increased 502s for a subset of dedicated customers (~2.3% of total traffic) between 02:00-02:10 UTC. No data loss; retries mostly succeeded.
carol: Left a note in infra runbook: kvcache-churn -> consider routing weight shift + warmup. Link: https://docs.redwood.example/runbooks/kvcache
maria: I'm going to hand off to sarah in 15m with checklist: monitor 5xx, ensure warmup job completes, prepare rollback of weight change if needed.
sarah: Acked. I have pager access and escalation contact list. Will monitor next hour and notify customers if we see regression.
jon: Marking mitigation: weight-shift + warmup + fallback-model applied. Remaining action: confirm warmup success and monitor evictions for 30m.
incident-bot: Incident severity set to SEV3 (degraded perf/customer errors). Tags: kvcache, routing, 5xx
maria: Updating INC-4729 with timeline and mitigation steps. Adding affected customer list for CS.
carol: :white_check_mark: good run. Moving to monitoring. If error-rate creeps >3% we revert weights and scale pool capacity.
maria: Ending active triage, will stay available for escalation. Handoff to sarah at 02:20 UTC.
sarah: Taking over. Thanks team.
